comment: KFU-015 (Turbopack era): ceilings on ACTUAL shipped client JS, measured from .next build artifacts — Turbopack removed per-route sizes from the build log, so the gate reads reality instead of scraping it. sharedEntryKB guards the framework/entry graph (build-manifest rootMainFiles); totalClientKB guards the whole client payload (a us-places-class re-entry blows it instantly). Calibrated 2026-08-20 against shared=447kB, total=4006kB/113 chunks. Raise only with a reviewed reason, ratchet-style like the lint ceiling.
